messages:
talia: Heads up — running into confusion in Console around credential visibility + sampling. A customer noticed some service account rows show 'sampled' in the attribution column while others show full counts. Anyone seen this behavior?
kevin: Yep. That's the adaptive telemetry sampler we toggled last week to cut export costs. It reduces per-key trace export for low-throughput keys.
mona: That makes sense, but we shouldn't surface it as an ambiguous status. New users read 'sampled' and think their quota/keys are broken.
sam: Important question: sampling only affects telemetry export, not quota enforcement or SLA math, right? I don't want customers thinking their quotas are skipped.
kevin: Correct — quota decisions use the aggregate counters in the metering pipeline. Sampling is post-hoc: we drop detailed attribution traces before indexing. The problem is the Console per-key panels are currently powered by the traces, so they show sampled/estimated values.
infra-bot: deploy: telemetry-sampler v2 -> canary 3% -> started 6390001200 :rocket:
talia: Proposal: 1) Add an explicit 'sampled' badge with a tooltip explaining "data estimated due to telemetry sampling; counts for enforcement come from billing metrics". 2) Show a small 'estimated' suffix on numbers derived from sampled traces. 3) Add an admin toggle for "full attribution (expensive)" for Dedicated/Private tenants.
mona: Also add a short line in SLO/dashboard pages: "Some rows show sampled estimates — see docs for implications." Link to a doc that explains the difference between sampled traces vs billing counters.
kevin: Implementation note: telemetry sampler should attach a header/flag to emitted payloads (e.g. `X-Telemetry-Sampled: true`) so Console can detect whether a panel is backed by sampled data instead of guessing. Config example: `sampling_config: { mode: "adaptive", ratio: 0.03 }` (we can make ratio a numeric string in config).
sam: SGTM. I'd add a fallback: if per-key traces are sampled OR missing, query the metric backend for an estimated count and mark it as "estimated (metrics)". UI should make clear which source it used.
talia: Action items: I'll draft the Console PR for the badge + suffix. Kevin to add explicit header in telemetry pipeline and expose a detection flag. Mona to own docs + admin toggle language. Can we target next week's minor release?
mona: :thumbsup: I'll take docs and add the admin toggle wording and a short troubleshooting FAQ.
kevin: I'll open the telemetry PR and the canary plan this afternoon. Will add the header so Console can rely on it.
talia: Thanks all — please add links to PRs here when ready. This should reduce support noise. :smile:
